notes:
{姑|しゅうとめ} refers specifically to the mother of one's spouse. It is the traditional native Japanese word (和語) for this relationship.

WRITING:
Often written in hiragana (しゅうとめ) because the kanji {姑} is not commonly known. In formal or legal contexts, ⟦{義母|ぎぼ}→義母：06724_gibo⟧ is preferred.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{嫁|よめ}→嫁：03670_yome⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{姑|しゅうとめ} (daughter-in-law and mother-in-law) relationship is a frequent topic in Japanese media and culture, often depicted as a source of family tension. The word ⟦{嫁姑|よめしゅうとめ}→嫁姑：noentry⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ refers to conflicts between these two roles.
